info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector V1consumer API
Microsoft Azure Consume Records Using A Simple Consumer

params.name: topic
params.description: Topic to consume the records from

params.name: partition
params.description: Partition ID to consume the records from

params.name: count
params.description: Number of records to consume (optional). By default count is 1. It returns either count of records or 6 megabytes of data, which is smaller.

items.docs: Consume records from one partition of a topic beginning with a specific offset. By default count is 1. It can read maximum of 6 megabytes of data at once
